workforceCategories.title: Technical Workforce
workforceCategories.description: Engineers, IT professionals, and diploma-qualified technicians sourced against formal qualifications and verified through credential checks and technical assessment.
workforceCategories.qualificationBasis: Engineering degree/diploma, technical certification, project or portfolio review
workforceCategories.idealFor: EU Blue Card (Germany, Poland), Specialist/Engineer visas (Japan), Gulf employment visas (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar)

workforceCategories.title: Non-Technical Workforce
workforceCategories.description: Skilled and semi-skilled trade workers sourced against hands-on experience, trade certification, and hands-on skill testing rather than formal degrees.
workforceCategories.qualificationBasis: Trade certificate / ITI, verified work experience, hands-on skill test, medical fitness
workforceCategories.idealFor: SSW & TITP (Japan), skilled worker visas (Germany), labor contracts (Russia, Gulf & Israel)
